title: Contract 7.2 common value types (library, not an instance schema)
description: Shared $defs for the Contract 7.2 common value types plus the closed kind/failure-action/permission vocabularies of 5.2/8/13.3. Referenced from the sibling DTO schemas via common-types.schema.json#/$defs/<name>; no cycles.

versioned_ref.description: Contract 7.2 VersionedRef; all three fields MUST be verified on resolution (6.2); never latest/naked/Graph-node.

rational.description: Contract 7.2 Rational; the only legal ratio encoding (6.1.4 - no floats in hashed cores).

json_schema_ref.description: Contract 7.2 JsonSchemaRef; REQUIRED on any Skill used as a Composite child (5.2.5/8.2-8.4).

extensions.description: Contract 6.4 extensions envelope. Keys are reverse-domain or organization namespaces; unknown required:true extensions fail closed (UNKNOWN_REQUIRED_EXTENSION); extensions never enter a core digest preimage unless the DTO explicitly freezes otherwise (6.2.1 manifest).

permission.description: Contract 8.1 permission entry; a capability without an explicit scope is invalid (CTR-005 permission profile).

predicate.description: Opaque applicability/branch predicate object (Contract 8.1-8.3); schema-validated by the enclosing kind validator, never executed.
